description: Revenue Report, Payment Analytics and /reports/dashboard return HTTP 500 for every date range. Postgres 42702 'column reference "id" is ambiguous' comes from prisma groupBy with _count:{id:true} plus the invoice→patient relation filter (reproduced by calling ReportsService directly). The month-end revenue review is impossible for every role. The mapped '₹0.00 cards' never render.
expected: Revenue totals, GST and the payment-mode split for the range.
actual: GET /reports/revenue returns 500 (retried 3× by the client); the page shows 'No data available for the selected period'.
suggested_fix: Use _count: { _all: true } (or count invoiceId) in the groupBy calls; add an integration test against Postgres.

description: Report API errors are swallowed (console.error) and rendered as the empty state 'No data available for the selected period'. An owner reads a server failure as 'no revenue'.
expected: An error state: 'Couldn't load this report. Retry.'
suggested_fix: Track an error state in generateReport and render it distinctly.

description: The report end date excludes the end day for createdAt metrics. Patient Analytics for 08 Oct–07 Nov shows Total 11, New 0, Returning 0, because all 11 patients were created on 07 Nov after midnight UTC. With end=08 Nov, newPatients=11. Appointment counts are unaffected (date-only storage). Mapped defect 9, confirmed for createdAt.
expected: The end date is inclusive through 23:59:59 IST.
actual: New Patients 0 on a day when 11 were registered.
suggested_fix: In calculateDateRange, set end to the end of the day in the clinic timezone.

description: The report output starts at y≈951 at 1280x800, below the System Alerts strip, six report cards and the date/controls card. Picking a report card or changing a date produces no visible change in the viewport. On mobile the output is about 5 screens down.
expected: The report output is visible together with its selector (e.g. compact tabs instead of six large cards).
actual: Every selection needs a scroll to see the result.
suggested_fix: Collapse the report cards into a tab or segmented control and move System Alerts below the report.

description: Patient Analytics 'Avg Age' shows 32, but the real mean of patients.age is 38.1. The page multiplies bucket counts by each bucket's lower bound. Mapped defect 21, confirmed.
suggested_fix: Return averageAge from the patient report query.

description: The System Alerts strip shows 'Low Stock 0' while the Inventory Report (GET /reports/inventory) returns lowStockItems: 4. Auth-topic defect 10, confirmed.

A start date after the end date is accepted: 'Report for 07 Nov 2026 to 01 Oct 2026' with all zeros and no message. The Quick Guide says 'Click Generate Report', but reports regenerate on every date change (two requests per range edit).
expected: An inline 'start must be before end'; guide copy that matches the behaviour.
